<objective>
Rewire `attachment-preview.component.ts` to delegate its ~600 lines of drawing (`render*`) and hit-test (`onCanvasClick`/`onCanvasMouseMove` distance geometry) to the `AttachmentCanvasRendererService` built in Plan 03 (01-03-PLAN.md), while preserving every public method name, `@Input()`/`@Output()`, and observable behavior the existing spec (`attachment-preview.component.spec.ts`) already exercises — that spec calls `component.renderPreview()`, reads `component.previewScale`, and spies on `setupResizeObserver`/`handleResize`, so those must remain on the shell with identical signatures and side effects.

This satisfies DECOMP-03 (Canvas rendering/interaction logic separated from selection state) and the ~400-line target: the shell keeps `@ViewChild(canvas)`, all thirteen `@Input()`s, the four `@Output()` emitters, `ngAfterViewInit`/`ngOnChanges`/`ngOnDestroy`, `ResizeObserver` setup, `calculatePreviewScale`/`previewScale`, mobile-device detection, and the subscriptions to `CustomAttachmentPointService`/`StateManagementService` — everything else moves through calls into the Plan 03 service.

Purpose: Complete DECOMP-03's decomposition without changing the component's external contract (consumed by `attachment-sidebar` per D-05) or its test-observable behavior.
Output: `attachment-preview.component.ts` shrunk to an orchestration shell; `.html` unchanged in structure (still hosts the single `<canvas>` + tooltip).
</objective>

    Edit `attachment-preview.component.ts` in place: keep the `@Component` decorator, all `@Input()`/`@Output()` declarations (including `selectedAttachmentPointId`/`hoveredAttachmentId` as parent-driven inputs per D-05 — do not add new internal fields for these), `@ViewChild('canvas')`, `ngAfterViewInit`/`ngOnChanges`/`ngOnDestroy`, the constructor's `CustomAttachmentPointService`/`StateManagementService` subscriptions, `updateMergedAttachmentPoints`, `updateCanvasSize`, `setupResizeObserver`/`handleResize`, `calculatePreviewScale`/`previewScale`, `detectMobileDevice`/`isMobileDevice`, and `getAttachmentPointRadius`/`getClickDetectionRadius` (these radius helpers are passed as data into the service's hitTest/hoverTest calls, or delegate to the service's own copy if Plan 03 relocated them — confirm against 01-03-SUMMARY.md and keep the shell's public radius getters if the spec touches them). Replace the bodies of `renderPreview()`, the private `render*` methods, and the image-cache internals with a single call into `AttachmentCanvasRendererService.render(params)` built from the shell's current `@Input()`/state values (including the parent-owned `selectedAttachmentPointId`/`hoveredAttachmentId`/`hoveredPointId`) — `renderPreview()` keeps its exact name and void signature since the spec spies on it (`spyOn(component, 'renderPreview')`, line ~343). Store the map returned by `render(params)` back into `this.attachmentPointPositions` (the existing field the tooltip template and hit-test read) so the `.html` template's `attachmentPointPositions[hoveredPointId]` binding keeps working unchanged. Replace `onCanvasClick`/`onCanvasMouseMove`'s inline distance-loop bodies with calls to `AttachmentCanvasRendererService.hitTest`/`hoverTest`, keeping the surrounding edit-mode/occupied-check/emit logic (`pointDeleted`, `attachmentPointClicked`, `customPointAdded`) on the shell exactly as today (this branching is shell-owned selection/interaction policy, not renderer concern, per D-05). Remove the now-dead private `render*` method bodies and `loadedImages`/`imagesLoading`/`loadImage` fields from the shell (they live in the service now). Do not change the `.html` template's structure (single canvas + tooltip) — only the `.ts` internals change.
  </action>
